note: Who won each 2024 Lok Sabha seat, keyed by the geometry unique_id (data/geo/india-pcs.json), with the member's Sansad member number (mpsno) from the Lok Sabha Secretariat member directory. The pages use mpsno only to link each member to their official page on sansad.in (https://sansad.in/ls/members/biography/<mpsno>), where the member's photograph is published; the atlas keeps no member photographs.
join: state + constituency against data/results/ls/pc/2024.json, then verified against the ECI 2024 declared winner in data/results/ls/detail/2024.json.
caveat: The directory lists members currently sitting, so it is valid for 2024 only. Where a by-election has since been held, the seat's general-election winner was re-joined by name against the same directory; see "by_election_corrections".
